items.prompt: The bar chart shows books borrowed from the school library. How many books were borrowed in the whole week?

figure.alt: Bar chart of books borrowed: Monday 12, Tuesday 18, Wednesday 9, Thursday 15, Friday 21.

hints: Read the value of each bar.

items.prompt: The pictogram shows the sport each child chose. Each star means 4 children. How many more children chose football than badminton?

figure.alt: Pictogram, each star is 4 children. Football 6 stars, swimming 4 stars, badminton 3 stars.

hints: Count the stars in each row.
items.explanation: Football has 6 stars and badminton has 3 stars. The difference is 3 stars, and 3 × 4 = 12 children.
